license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dietetics in this state for compensation or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is practicing dietetics unless he or she has been duly licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225.

issuing_authority.value: Division of Professional Registration, State Committee of Dietitians
issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby created within the division of professional registration, a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians".

name.quote: There is hereby created within the division of professional registration, a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians".

type.quote: There is hereby created within the division of professional registration, a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians". The committee shall assist the division in administering and enforcing the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225

umbrella_agency.quote: the director of the division of professional registration

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for licensure as a dietitian shall be at least twenty-one years of age.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree from a regionally accredited institution plus completion of a didactic program in dietetics accredited by ACEND
degree_required.quote: The applicant has completed a didactic program in dietetics which is approved or accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics and a minimum of a baccalaureate degree from an acceptable educational institution accredited by a regional accrediting body or accredited by an accrediting body which has been approved by the United States Department of Education.

accrediting_body.value: Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND)
accrediting_body.quote: completed a didactic program in dietetics which is approved or accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics

degree_level.quote: a minimum of a baccalaureate degree from an acceptable educational institution accredited by a regional accrediting body

school_approval_basis.quote: completed a didactic program in dietetics which is approved or accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics

credential_pegged.quote: possess a current registration with the Commission on Dietetic Registration. The committee may waive the examination requirement and grant licensure to an applicant for a license as a dietitian who presents satisfactory evidence to the committee of current registration as a dietitian with the commission on dietetic registration.

required.quote: The applicant has completed a supervised practice requirement from an institution that is certified by a nationally recognized professional organization as having a dietetics specialty or who meets criteria for dietetics education established by the committee.

experience_source.quote: The applicant has completed a supervised practice requirement from an institution that is certified by a nationally recognized professional organization as having a dietetics specialty or who meets criteria for dietetics education established by the committee.

kind.quote: The applicant has completed a supervised practice requirement from an institution that is certified by a nationally recognized professional organization as having a dietetics specialty

exams.name: Registration Examination for Dietitians (Commission on Dietetic Registration)
exams.notes: Committee may waive the examination if the applicant holds current CDR registration. Applicants who fail 3 times must submit evidence of additional coursework/experience before re-examination.
exams.quote: The applicant shall successfully pass an examination as determined by the committee and possess a current registration with the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

interval_years.quote: An inactive license shall be renewed biennially.

available.quote: The committee may issue a license to any dietitian who has a valid current license to practice dietetics or medical nutrition therapy in another country, provided that such person is licensed in a country whose requirements for licensure are substantially equal to, or greater than, the requirements for licensure of dietitians in Missouri

requirements.value: Valid current license from a country with requirements substantially equal to or greater than Missouri's licensure requirements
requirements.quote: licensed in a country whose requirements for licensure are substantially equal to, or greater than, the requirements for licensure of dietitians in Missouri at the time the applicant applies for licensure.

exists.quote: There is hereby created within the division of professional registration, a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians". The committee shall assist the division in administering and enforcing the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225

name.quote: a committee to be known as the "State Committee of Dietitians"

authority.value: The committee assists the division in administering and enforcing the act, adopts rules and regulations, approves examinations, and recommends prosecutions; it has delegated rulemaking and disciplinary recommendation authority but operates within the Division of Professional Registration.
authority.quote: The committee shall assist the division in administering and enforcing the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225, adopt, publish, and enforce such rules and regulations within the scope and purview of the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225 as may be considered to be necessary or proper

national_certification.quote: possess a current registration with the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

national_association.value: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics (via ACEND)
national_association.quote: "Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics" or "ACEND", the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics accrediting agency for education programs preparing students for professions as registered dietitians

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dietetics in this state for compensation or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is practicing dietetics unless he or she has been duly licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225.

credential_type.quote: "Licensed dietitian", a person who is licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225 to engage in the practice of dietetics or medical nutrition therapy

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dietetics in this state for compensation or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is practicing dietetics unless he or she has been duly licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225.

title_protection.quote: No other person may use the title "Dietitian" or the abbreviation "L.D." or "L.D.N.". No other person shall assume any title or use any title or use any abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs, or devices to indicate that the person using the same is a licensed dietitian.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dietetics in this state for compensation or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is practicing dietetics unless he or she has been duly licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing a license or obtaining permission to take the examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing a license issued pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225 or in obtaining permission to take the examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating any person holding a license or allowing any person to use one's license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a license or allowing any person to use his or her license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against the holder by another state, territory, federal agency, or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in Missouri
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice medical nutrition therapy by another state, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a license based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Finally adjudicated guilty or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere for any offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution pursuant to the laws of any state, of the United States, or of any country, for any offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of professional functions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of the functions or duties of the profession that is regulated by sections 324.200 to 324.225

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or assisting any person to violate any provision of the act or lawful rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 324.200 to 324.225, or any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to such sections

disciplinary_grounds.description: Finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading or deceptive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use or unlawful possession of any controlled substance or alcoholic beverage to an extent that it impairs ability to perform the work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use or unlawful possession of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession that is licensed or regulated by sections 324.200 to 324.225

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state, or the federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence.

definition_quote.value: the application of principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, management, and behavioral and social science to achieve and maintain the health of people by providing nutrition assessment and nutrition care services
definition_quote.quote: the application of principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, management, and behavioral and social science to achieve and maintain the health of people by providing nutrition assessment and nutrition care services

value: Assessing the nutrition needs of individuals and groups
Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives that meet nutrition needs
Providing nutrition counseling or education in health and disease
Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems
Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining appropriate standards of quality and safety in food and in nutrition services
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the nutrition needs of individuals and groups and determining resources and constraints in the practice setting; Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives that meet nutrition needs and are consistent with available resources and constraints; Providing nutrition counseling or education in health and disease; Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems; Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining appropriate standards of quality and safety in food and in nutrition services; Engaged in medical nutritional therapy

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian", a person who is licensed pursuant to the provisions of sections 324.200 to 324.225 to engage in the practice of dietetics or medical nutrition therapy

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The committee may waive the examination requirement and grant licensure to an applicant for a license as a dietitian who presents satisfactory evidence to the committee of current registration as a dietitian with the commission on dietetic registration.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy", the provision of nutrition care services for the treatment or management of a disease or medical condition

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: Nothing in sections 324.200 to 324.225 shall be construed to authorize any person licensed pursuant to sections 324.200 to 324.225 as a licensed dietitian to engage in any manner of the practice of medicine as defined by the laws of this state.

value: Self-care or gratuitous care by a friend or family member
Persons in the military services or working in federal facilities
Licensed health care providers performing activities within their scope of practice
Individuals marketing or distributing food products including dietary supplements
Any person furnishing general nutrition information
A person credentialed in the field of nutrition providing advice outside of medical nutrition therapy
exempt_professions_list.quote: nothing in sections 324.200 to 324.225 is intended to limit, preclude, or otherwise interfere with: Self-care by a person or gratuitous care by a friend or family member; Persons in the military services or working in federal facilities from performing any activities described in sections 324.200 to 324.225 during the course of their assigned duties; A licensed health care provider performing any activities described in sections 324.200 to 324.225 that are within the scope of practice of the licensee; A person pursuing an approved educational program leading to a degree or certificate in dietetics; Individuals who do not hold themselves out as dietitians marketing or distributing food products including dietary supplements; Any person furnishing general nutrition information as to the use of food, food materials, or dietary supplements; A person credentialed in the field of nutrition from providing advice, counseling, or evaluations in matters of food, diet, or nutrition to the extent such acts are within the scope of practice listed by the credentialing body and do not constitute medical nutrition therapy

federal_employee_exemption.quote: Persons in the military services or working in federal facilities from performing any activities described in sections 324.200 to 324.225 during the course of their assigned duties in the military service or a federal facility

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: Individuals who do not hold themselves out as dietitians marketing or distributing food products including dietary supplements as defined by the Food and Drug Administration or engaging in the explanation and education of customers regarding the use of such products

protected_titles.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice dietetics in this state may use the title "Dietitian" or the abbreviation "L.D." or "L.D.N.". No other person may use the title "Dietitian" or the abbreviation "L.D." or "L.D.N.".

inactive_license_status_available.quote: A licensed dietitian may choose not to renew his or her license and thereby allow such license to lapse, or may ask to be put on inactive status, provided such person does not practice dietetics during such period that the license is lapsed or the practitioner is on inactive status.
